subject: Intercom + Gainsight bundle proposal — pricing & migration plan
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Cheng <olivia.cheng@brightline.ai>, Intercom Sales <sales@intercom-partner.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: RFP: Intercom + Gainsight bundle — quick context and ask

Olivia / team,

Thanks again for the materials you shared on Monday. To make the internal evaluation efficient, can you send a single bundled proposal that includes: 1) line-item pricing for Intercom seats + Gainsight license tiers, 2) a migration timeline for users and historical ticket migration, and 3) an SLO / support response commitment for the first 6 months post-migration.

High-level constraints from our side: we need a pilot of ~120 seats (support + CS) starting September 1, with full cutover by Q4 if the pilot meets SLA and usage goals. Key decision factors are predictable unit economics, an integration approach for product telemetry into Gainsight, and references for customers that migrated from Zendesk in the last 18 months.

I attached our RFP (Redwood-Support-RFP-20260708.pdf) for details — we expect a formal bundled quote and an updated runbook by EOD Friday. If you prefer a 30m sync before you prepare the quote, suggest Thu 11am PT.

—Aditya
Director, Platform & Developer Experience
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Support-RFP-20260708.pdf

From: Olivia Cheng <olivia.cheng@brightline.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: sales@intercom-partner.com, gainsight-sales@gainsight.com
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 17:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: RFP: Intercom + Gainsight bundle — quick context and ask

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP.

Summary of what we can deliver by Fri EOD: a bundled commercial PDF (seat-by-seat), a recommended migration plan (30/60/90 day phases), and a first-draft runbook for ticket migration. We have a couple of migration references (RetailCo and BrightApps) we can include — both cutover from Zendesk within the last 14 months.

Quick notes up front:
- We can offer a pilot price that is ~18% below list for the first 120 seats if you commit to a 12-month term following pilot conversion.
- Gainsight is offering a $35k implementation credit if we hit the timeline and use the Brightline integration package.
- For SLA: a 1-hour P1 response and 4-hour P2 response during business hours can be included at enterprise tier.

If Thu 11am PT works, I’ll send a calendar invite for 30m — otherwise we’ll deliver the packet as promised on Friday.

Best,
Olivia Cheng
Strategic Accounts, Brightline (Intercom Channel Partner)
olivia.cheng@brightline.ai

Attachments referenced: Intercom-Gainsight-bundle-pricing-20260708.xlsx, migration-runbook-draft.docx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Cheng <olivia.cheng@brightline.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: RFP: Intercom + Gainsight bundle — quick context and ask

Olivia — that pricing note is helpful, thanks. A couple follow-ups before the packet: 

1) Can Brightline/Intercom split the pilot discount such that the first 3 months are deeper (25% off) with a tiered step-up to the 12-month committed price? That helps us control runway if the integration work runs long.
2) Does Gainsight’s $35k implementation credit require a separate SOW or is it baked into the bundle? We’d prefer a single SOW and a single PO.
3) Any hard limits on historic ticket migration size per week? Our Zendesk export is ~2.1M tickets historically but only ~250k are active within the last 3 years. We need a migration cadence that keeps our support team productive.

If you can call out these items in the Friday packet, we’ll be set for the internal review. Also cc’ing Vivek to flag finance procurement constraints for any multi-year commitments.

Thanks — Aditya

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: aditya.rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0000
Subject: Internal: procurement constraints & legal review request

Aditya / Marissa / Vivek —

Quick internal note after reading Olivia’s initial reply (quoted below): please flag the following for procurement/legal:
- We prefer single-contract ownership (Intercom + Gainsight) if Brightline can act as the reseller/prime contractor. Avoid separate multi-vendor SOWs if possible.
- We need a clearly defined exit/rollback plan in the contract (e.g., portability of conversation data, KV exports, and runbook acceptance criteria).
- Any volume discounts should include defined breakpoints and audited usage reports monthly.

Marissa — can you engage Legal and tag Procurement (PO workflow) so we have a standard appendix for data portability and an SLA credits clause? Vivek — if terms require multi-year prepayment, we’ll need an executive approval path (I can draft language for a term-limited cap).

Thanks — Laura
Head of Support Operations

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 14:25:00 -0000
Subject: Re: RFP: Intercom + Gainsight bundle — revised commercial + DocuSign link

Aditya / Laura / team —

Attached is a revised commercial (see Intercom-Gainsight-bundle-pricing-20260712.xlsx). Key updates per your asks:
- Pilot pricing: 25% off for months 1-3, then 12% off for months 4-12 if you convert to a 12-mo term.
- Gainsight credit: $35k credit applied against implementation fees; documented in the bundled SOW (single SOW maintained by Brightline as prime).
- Migration cadence: recommended 20k tickets/week for more recent tickets, archive-only migration for older tickets; runbook acceptance criteria attached.

We’ve generated an initial DocuSign envelope for the bundled SOW so Legal/Procurement can preview terms: https://www.docusign.com/rdw/packet/IC-GS-2026

If the commercial looks acceptable we can schedule an SOW walkthrough with Legal this week.

—Kevin Park
Account Executive, Intercom Partner (Brightline)
kevin.park@intercom-partner.com

Subject: Re: RFP: Intercom + Gainsight bundle — pricing & migration plan

Kevin / Olivia — thanks for the quick turnaround and the DocuSign preview. The revised commercial hits the main asks — pilot pricing and the single-SOW approach are acceptable.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Marissa will coordinate Legal/Procurement to review the DocuSign SOW and circulate a marked-up version by Tue 21 Jul.
- Vivek — Finance will confirm budget cadence; if procurement needs a cap on multi-year prepayment, I’ll route an executive approval request.
- We’ll schedule the SOW walkthrough for Fri 17 Jul with Legal and the Intercom contract attorney. Please send an invite with dial-in.

Kevin — please include the migration runbook (finalized) in the DocuSign packet before execution.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot kicked off.

—Aditya
Director, Platform & Developer Experience
Redwood Inference
